item.title: And then there were three: The concerning decline of Black NFL head coaches
item.description: The NFL, the most popular sport in the United States, began this season with six Black head coaches of its 32 franchises. It is now down to three, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers Todd Bowles, the Houston Texans DeMeco Ryans and the New York Jets’ Aaron Glenn.
